q: What is the correct indirect form of: He said, “You had better see a doctor”?
o: He advised me to see a doctor
He advised that he should see a doctor
He proposed to see a doctor
He suggested that he had seen a doctor
e: “You had better ...” পরামর্শ দেয়, তাই indirect-এ reporting verb advised বসে আর পরামর্শটি to-infinitive-এ যায়। এখানে you হল শ্রোতা, তাই me হয়। সঠিক রূপ: He advised me to see a doctor (সে আমাকে ডাক্তার দেখাতে পরামর্শ দিল)। অন্য অপশনে you বদলে he বসে অর্থ বদলে গেছে, আর had seen কালেও ভুল।

q: Abul said, “I was busy.” বাক্যটির Indirect speech হবে -
o: Abul said that I was busy.
Abul said that he was busy.
Abul said that I had been busy.
Abul said that he had been busy.
e: reporting verb past হলে reported speech-এর past indefinite বদলে past perfect হয়: was → had been, আর I হয় he।
s: প্রাথমিক শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর, প্রাক-প্রাথমিক সহকারী শিক্ষক (দাজলা) (২০১৩)

q: He said, “I have been working since sunrise.” Make it indirect speech.
o: He said that he has been working since sunrise
He said that he has worked for sunrise
He said that he had been working since sunrise
He said that he is working since sunrise
e: Reported speech present perfect continuous (have been working) হলে reporting verb past থাকলে indirect-এ তা past perfect continuous (had been working) হয়। Person-এ I হয় he। তাই “He said that he had been working since sunrise” (সে বলল সূর্যোদয় থেকে সে কাজ করছিল)। বাকি অপশনে tense বদলানো হয়নি অথবা অর্থ নষ্ট হয়েছে, যেমন “for sunrise”।

q: The teacher said, “The earth moves round the sun.” Make it indirect speech.
o: The teacher said that the earth moved round the sun
The teacher said that the earth moves round the sun
The teacher said that the earth has moved round the sun
The teacher said that the earth had moved round the sun
e: পৃথিবী সূর্যের চারদিকে ঘোরে, এটি বৈজ্ঞানিক সত্য। Reporting verb past হলেও চিরন্তন বা বৈজ্ঞানিক সত্য indirect speech-এ বদলায় না, তাই moves-ই থাকে। সঠিক রূপ: The teacher said that the earth moves round the sun। Moved বা had moved লিখলে সত্যটিকে অতীতের ঘটনা বানিয়ে ফেলা হয়, যা ভুল। একই নিয়মে ‘The sun rises in the east’ বা ‘Man is mortal’ অপরিবর্তিত থাকে।

q: The indirect form of the sentence "We were told, the match had already started when she arrived" is
o: We were told the match had already started when she arrived.
We were told the match had already started when she had arrived.
We were told the match had already been started when she arrived.
Between you and me, I doubt that he would come.

q: Select the correct indirect form of the following sentence: He said to me, “You are always unreliable.”
o: He said to me that I am going to be unreliable
He told me that I was always unreliable
He told me I had been always unreliable
He told me that I would be unreliable
e: Said to ... রূপান্তরে told বসে। Reported speech-এর present (are) হয় past (was), আর second person “you” হয় reporting verb-এর object অনুযায়ী I। তাই “He told me that I was always unreliable” (সে আমাকে বলল আমি সবসময় অবিশ্বস্ত)। “Would be” ও “am going to be” কালের ভাব বদলে দেয়, আর “had been” অকারণে এক ধাপ বেশি পিছিয়ে যায়।

q: “If I were you, I wouldn’t go,” he said. The indirect speech is:
o: He told me to stay with me
He asked me not to go
He advised me against going
He advised me never to go
e: “If I were you, I wouldn’t ...” থেকে বোঝা যায় বক্তা না করার পরামর্শ দিচ্ছে। তাই reporting verb advised, আর advise against + gerund গঠনটি ব্যবহার করা হয়। সঠিক রূপ: He advised me against going (সে আমাকে যেতে নিষেধ করার পরামর্শ দিল)। Asked সাধারণ অনুরোধ, never to go অতিরিক্ত জোর দেয় (কখনোই নয়), আর প্রথম অপশন ব্যাকরণ ও অর্থ দুই দিক থেকেই ভুল।

q: The son asked his mother if he ___.
o: can go out
may go out
might go out
did go out
e: reporting verb asked অতীত কালের, তাই বক্তার কথায় থাকা বর্তমান modal অতীত রূপ নেয়: may → might। তাই might go out সঠিক। অর্থ: ছেলে তার মাকে জিজ্ঞেস করল সে বাইরে যেতে পারে কি না। can go out এবং may go out বর্তমান কাল, যা asked-এর সাথে মেলে না। did go out অনুমতির ভাব দেয় না।

q: He said, ‘You are a fool.’ (To indirect speech)
o: He said that I was a fool.
He called me a fool.
He said that you a fool.
He said that the man was a fool.

q: Mother said to me, "I saw him." Which one is indirect form of this?
o: Mother said to me that I have seen him
Mother said to me that I saw him
Mother told me that she had seen him
Mother told me that I saw him

q: The indirect form of the sentence He said, “I did not refuse to help” is:
o: He said that he does not want to help
He denied that he had refused to help
He denied that he refused to help
He said he did not refuse to help
e: নেতিবাচক বাক্যে কেউ অভিযোগ অস্বীকার করলে indirect-এ denied that ব্যবহার করা যায়। Reported speech-এর past indefinite (did not refuse) reporting verb past হলে past perfect (had refused) হয়। তাই “He denied that he had refused to help” (সে অস্বীকার করল যে সে সাহায্য করতে অস্বীকৃত হয়েছিল)। Denied নিজেই নেতিবাচক, তাই ভেতরে আর not লাগে না। অন্য অপশনে কাল ঠিক নেই বা অর্থ বদলে গেছে।

q: Choose the indirect speech of the following: He said, “Would that I were rich.”
o: He wished he would be rich
He said that he were rich
He wished he had been rich
He said would that he were rich
e: “Would that I were ...” অপূর্ণ ইচ্ছা বোঝায়, তাই indirect-এ wished দিয়ে প্রকাশ হয়। বাস্তবের উল্টো অবস্থা অতীত ইচ্ছায় যায়, ফলে were rich হয় had been rich। সঠিক রূপ: He wished he had been rich। ‘Would be rich’ ভবিষ্যৎ ইচ্ছা আনে, ‘said that he were’ ব্যাকরণ ও ভাব দুই দিকেই ভুল, আর শেষ অপশনে indirect রূপ হয়নি।

q: The right direct speech of “The teacher enquired why I had been absent from class” is:
o: The teacher said to me, “Why are you absent from class?”
The teacher said to me, “Why you have been absent from class?”
The teacher said to me, “Why were you been absenting from class?”
The teacher said to me, “Why were you absent from class?”
e: Indirect-এর past perfect (had been) direct-এ ফিরলে past indefinite (were) হয়। Enquired why হয় said to me, “Why ...?”, আর প্রশ্নের ক্রম ফিরে আসে (were you absent)। I হয় you। তাই “Why were you absent from class?” সঠিক। অন্য অপশনে কালের ভুল (are), প্রশ্নের ক্রমের ভুল (you have been) বা অর্থহীন গঠন (been absenting) আছে।

q: He said, “I met her long ago.” The correct indirect speech is:
o: He said that he met her long ago
He said that he had met her long ago
He said that he was met her long ago
He said that he has met her long ago
e: Reporting verb past হলে reported speech-এর past indefinite (met) বদলে past perfect (had met) হয়। “Long ago” indirect-এ সাধারণত “long before” হয়, তবু এই প্রশ্নে অপশন থেকে বেছে নিতে হলে had met-ই ঠিক। “was met” ভুল গঠন, আর “has met” present perfect, যা past reporting verb-এর সাথে চলে না।

q: I asked him if he ___ his lessons.
o: has prepared
is preparing
had prepared
has been preparing
e: 'asked' অতীত কাল, তাই reported speech এ 'if' দিয়ে শুরু clause-এর verb অতীতে সরে যায়। সরাসরি উক্তিতে 'Have you prepared your lessons?' থাকলে present perfect, যা indirect এ past perfect হয়, তাই 'had prepared'। অর্থ: আমি তাকে জিজ্ঞেস করলাম সে তার পাঠ তৈরি করেছে কিনা। 'has prepared' ও 'is preparing' বর্তমান কাল। 'has been preparing' ও অতীতে সরে না।

q: He said, “Where are my glasses?” Its indirect form is:
o: He asked where are my glasses
He asked where were his glasses
He asked where his glasses were
He asked where his glasses had been
e: Wh-প্রশ্নের indirect-এ বিবৃতির ক্রম হয়: Wh-শব্দ + কর্তা + ক্রিয়া। তাই where are my glasses হয় where his glasses were। My বদলে বক্তা he অনুযায়ী his হয়, আর are বদলে were হয় (reporting verb past)। সঠিক রূপ: He asked where his glasses were। প্রথম ও দ্বিতীয় অপশনে প্রশ্নের ক্রম রয়ে গেছে, আর ‘had been’ কাল অনর্থক পিছিয়ে দেয়।

q: He said, "What a pity!" বাক্যটির indirect speech হবে-
o: He said that it was a great pity
He exclaimed that it is a great pity
He exclaimed that it was a great pity
He exclaimed that it is great pity
e: Exclamatory বাক্যে said বদলে exclaimed হয় এবং 'What a' বদলে 'a great' বসে। Reporting verb অতীতে থাকায় is বদলে was হবে: He exclaimed that it was a great pity।
s: প্রাথমিক শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর, সহকারী শিক্ষক (হেমন্ত; মুক্তিযোদ্ধাদের সন্তানদের জন্য বিশেষ) (২০১০)

q: He said to his friends. "Let us play now"- বাক্যের indirect speech হচ্ছে-
o: He requested to his friends that they should play then.
He proposed to his friends that they would play then.
He proposed to his friends that they should play then.
He proposed to his friends that we should play then.
e: 'Let us' দিয়ে প্রস্তাব বোঝালে reporting verb হয় 'proposed to', আর 'let us' হয়ে যায় 'that they should'। একই সঙ্গে 'now' বদলে হয় 'then'।
s: প্রাথমিক শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর, প্রাক-প্রাথমিক সহকারী শিক্ষক (মিসিসিপি) (২০১৩)

q: Choose the correct indirect form.
o: She said that she was happy to be there that evening.
She said she was happy to be there that evening.
She said that she is happy to be there that evening.
She said that she were happy to be there that evening.
e: Direct বাক্যটি সম্ভবত She said, "I am happy to be here this evening"। Indirect-এ am থেকে was, here থেকে there এবং this evening থেকে that evening হয়, আর সংযোজক that বসে। তাই রূপ She said that she was happy to be there that evening। খ বাক্যটিও ইংরেজিতে ভুল নয়, কারণ that কথ্য ভাষায় উহ্য থাকতে পারে, তবে পরীক্ষার প্রচলিত নিয়মে that দেওয়া রূপকেই সঠিক ধরা হয়। গ-তে is না বদলানোয় এবং ঘ-তে she-এর সঙ্গে were বসানোয় ভুল। Indirect speech-এ now থেকে then, today থেকে that day, tomorrow থেকে the next day হয়, এটি পরীক্ষায় প্রায়ই আসে।

q: Put the following sentence into indirect speech: “Why are you getting wet in the rain?” I said.
o: I told why he was getting wet in the rain
I asked why he were getting wet in the rain
I asked why he was getting wet in the rain
I asked were why he getting wet in the rain
e: প্রশ্নের indirect-এ reporting verb হয় asked, আর Wh-শব্দ (why) অপরিবর্তিত থাকে। Are getting বদলে was getting হয়, কারণ reporting verb past, আর you বদলে he হয় (যাকে বলা হয়েছে)। তাই “I asked why he was getting wet in the rain”। Told প্রশ্নের জন্য ভুল, ‘he were’ কর্তা-ক্রিয়ার মিলে ভুল, আর শেষ অপশনে শব্দক্রম এলোমেলো।
